question: Within 110 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant aligned with the route to Tradewinds Airport Hotel, Inglewood, CA from the Last House on Mulholland, Los Angeles, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.320457 34.131243)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.348583 33.945195)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.320457 34.131243)',4326)::geography, 110000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.320457 34.131243)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.poi_name: Chef Marilyn's, Queen of Down Home Southern Goodies

[3].display_name: The Last House on Mulholland, Los Angeles, CA
